title: A Life on Our Planet: My Witness Statement and a Vision for the Future
author: David Attenborough with Jonnie Hughes
target_audience: General readers interested in nature and the environment
Individuals concerned about climate change and biodiversity loss
core_themes: Human impact on the natural world
Hope and solutions for the environmental crisis
primary_purpose: To bear witness to the drastic changes and degradation of the natural world witnessed over Attenborough’s lifetime, raise awareness about the severity of the environmental crisis facing Earth, and present a hopeful, practical vision for restoring the planet’s ecological balance for future generations.

structure_format.narrative_style: Reflective, first-person memoir interwoven with factual reporting and analysis
structure_format.organization: Three main parts: Attenborough’s witness statement (reflection on environmental damage over his lifetime), explanation of the current environmental crisis, and a call to action with practical recommendations for the future

key_concepts_lessons: The natural world has suffered severe loss of biodiversity and habitat due to human activity over a single lifetime.
Human prosperity is inextricably linked to the health of the Earth’s ecosystems.
Climate change and habitat destruction threaten not only nature but also humanity’s future.
Urgent and systemic changes are required in how we produce food, use land and energy, and manage resources.
It is not too late to restore the planet’s health if societies act now, prioritizing rewilding, renewable energy, sustainable consumption, and global cooperation.
notable_features: Blends memoir with environmental science and advocacy
Draws on Attenborough’s unique life experiences as a naturalist and broadcaster
Accompanied by a Netflix documentary of the same name
Highlights successful environmental recovery stories to illustrate hope
cultural_historical_context: Published in 2020 amidst growing concern over climate change, extinction rates, and global environmental movements. The book reflects Attenborough’s decades-long career documenting the changing natural world and marks his most direct advocacy for action.
reception_impact: International bestseller and critically acclaimed for its clarity and heartfelt urgency
Widely used to raise awareness and inform environmental discussions
Praised by environmentalists, educators, and readers for balancing realism with hope
Has influenced public opinion and policy dialogues regarding conservation and sustainability
comparable_titles: The Uninhabitable Earth by David Wallace-Wells
Our Planet (Netflix series and companion book)
The Sixth Extinction by Elizabeth Kolbert
This Changes Everything by Naomi Klein
